title: Implement BLAS/TLAS and SBT utilities with camera CBV integration
purpose: Factor reusable builders for AS and SBT, wire a camera constant buffer, and validate per-frame updates.

steps.detail: Create BLAS builder for triangle geometry; compute scratch/AS buffer sizes; allocate and build.
Create TLAS builder for instance array; support transforms, instance masks, build flags.
Create SBT builder that packs shader identifiers + root arguments into raygen/miss/hit sections with correct strides/alignments.
Add camera constant buffer; update per-frame; bind via global RS; pass to raygen.
Instrument AS/SBT build and camera update with PIX events.

acceptance: AS rebuild works without leaks; scratch sized correctly
SBT sizes and strides logged; PIX shows expected layout
references: Microsoft Learn – DXR state objects and SBT
